resources.string: Full screen brightness while the app is open, for shooting outdoors. Off: the system brightness. It drains the battery and heats the phone.
English or Spanish, independent of the phone\'s language.
Opens the guide in your browser (GitHub): first start, recording, controls, multicamera and troubleshooting.
Hide what you do not use. Hiding a group only removes its controls; it never changes what is recorded.
Every setting goes back to its default, including the recording folder and the audio settings.
Import .cube and .3dl files, organise them in folders and download makers\' LUTs.
Nothing here yet. Import a .cube or .3dl file.
Official conversion LUTs. They cannot be shipped with the app, so they are downloaded from the maker\'s website when you ask.
From %1$s (%2$s), %3$s MB. The file is checked against its known checksum and saved in the library.
The maker\'s terms apply: for your own use, not for redistribution.
The folder, its sub-folders and every LUT in them are deleted.
The LUT is removed from the library. Recordings already made keep their look.
Only .cube and .3dl files can be imported
The file is not a valid LUT
A folder with that name already exists
It is no longer in the library
Download failed: check the connection and try again
The downloaded file does not match the catalogue (the maker may have changed it); nothing was saved
The library could not be written

Also save a small 720p H.264 copy of each take (_proxy.mp4) with the same audio, for quick review and for paired devices to download. 10-bit takes get the monitor view so the proxy looks right anywhere.
Record another camera of this phone at the same time (1080p30, its own file), with a small preview. Only on phones that can stream two cameras together; it may lower the main camera\'s maximum mode.
Which pair to record. It applies when one of the two is the lens chosen on the camera screen.
Volume up or down starts and stops recording on the camera screen.
Measure which recording modes this phone really holds (one or two minutes).
Time of day (the timecode stamped in the takes)
The chosen input is not connected. Recording from %1$s; it is used again when it comes back.
Bluetooth headsets record in call mode: narrow-band mono audio, well below a USB or built-in microphone.
Also save each take\'s audio as an uncompressed WAV next to the video, starting with its first frame, for editing.
The video always carries AAC audio at 192 kbit/s, 48 kHz stereo.
Home, locking the screen or another app do not stop a take or the multicamera camera role; a notification shows it. Off: the take is saved when the app leaves the screen.
A short vibration the first time battery, storage or heat becomes critical.
Protect the phone: step down automatically
When the phone is about to overheat during a take, the next take starts one mode lower. The take in progress never changes. Off: the lower mode is only offered.
Auto: the best this phone offers (maker HDR, Ultra HDR or our own fusion)
Adds a Portrait chip to photo mode when this phone can measure depth (a depth camera, the maker\'s portrait mode, or two back cameras with Experimental on). Off: none of it runs.
MOV (QuickTime, for Final Cut Pro and Premiere)
Both carry the start timecode (time of day) for the editor. Applies from the next take.
Recorded when the camera\'s look picker has no recording look (None).
Also saves …_base.jpg next to each styled photo, so its style can be redone later.
